name: Mustafa Hamied
forbes_bio: Mustafa Hamied was the non-executive vice chairman of Mumbai generics maker Cipla until September 2024, when he resigned citing his age and health.
Cipla was founded in 1935 by his father Khwaja Abdul Hamied, a disciple of Mahatma Gandhi.
After the patriarch passed away in 1972, Mustafa, a science graduate from Bombay University, inherited the business along with his older brother Yusuf Hamied, also a billionaire.
His daughter Samina, who was executive vice-chairperson of Cipla, stepped down in March 2024. His son Kamil was appointed to the board in September 2024.

name: Zan Shengda

forbes_bio: Zan Shengda chairs investment company Nantong Zongyi Investment.
Zan investments over the years have ranged include financial services, spirits, dairy and software.
Zan holds an EMBA degree from Tsinghua University.

name: Wen Yibo
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2011-2021); Hurun Global (2014-2020); Hurun China (2007-2019)
forbes_bio: Wen Yibo, a former government engineer, leads Shenzhen-listed Sound Environmental Resources and Hong Kong-listed Sound Global.
Wen holds a degree in environmental engineering from Langzhou Jiaotong University and a master's in the same field from Tsinghua University.

name: Zhang Xuansong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2006-2026)
forbes_bio: Zhang chairs Yonghui Superstores, an operator of hypermarkets and supermarkets.
His brother Zhang Xuanning is the vice chairman of Yonghui Superstores.
Yonghui Superstore listed on Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2010.

name: Omani Carson
forbes_bio: Omani Carson is the founder and chairman of Omaha-based financial advisory company Carson Group, made up of Carson Wealth, Carson Coaching and Carson Partners.
The company runs 150 partner offices serving 54,000 affluent families, managing $55 billion in assets.
Carson launched the Carson Group in 1983 out of his dorm room at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
In 2022, a Lakota chief gave him the name Ta Te Omani (walking into a stiff wind) leading him to change his name from Ron to Omani.
He also runs Omya, a by-invitation-only venture targeting founders who are financially successful but personally stuck.

name: Zach Perret
forbes_bio: Zach Perret is CEO of Plaid, which helps other fintechs connect to customers' bank accounts so the customers can make deposits and payments.
Perret and his cofounder William Hockey met as junior Bain consultants before founding Plaid in 2012.
Plaid's customers include Robinhood, Coinbase and Venmo.
Visa called off a $5.3 billion deal to buy Plaid in early 2021 after the Department of Justice filed an antitrust lawsuit aiming to block the acquisition.
Perret graduated from Duke University and previously served on the board of trustees.

name: Stuart Miller
sec_insider_companies: LENNAR CORP /NEW/ (LEN, LEN.B) - Exec. Chairman, CEO, President; Millrose Properties, Inc. (MRP) - See Remarks
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2025); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Stuart Miller is executive chairman and co-CEO of homebuilder Lennar Corporation.
His father, Leonard Miller, was an early investor who took Lennar public in 1971 and helped grow it into a giant.
Lennar has built more than 1 million homes across 26 states. It did $35 billion in fiscal 2024 revenue.
Miller started working on Lennar's lawn crew at age 12. He took over as CEO in 1997.

name: Vijay Agarwal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2024-2025); Hurun India (2017-2019)
forbes_bio: Vijay Agarwal founded construction equipment maker Action Construction Equipment in 1995.
He is chairman and managing director of the company, which makes hydraulic mobile cranes, tower cranes, loaders, tractors and agri-harvesters.
The company sells construction equipment under the brand name Ace.
His wife Mona and son Sorab work with him and have board seats.
Action's list of clients includes the Tata Group, engineering giant Larsen & Toubro and billionaire Anand Mahindra's Mahindra group.
